verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer docs say you can register for free to get a personal API key, which is a free entry point to the API. The pack does not say whether that free key includes any conversion allowance. The pricing evidence shows only paid prepaid packages (10 cents per minute), so free testing of real conversions is implied at best. Missing for 10: documented free conversion quota or trial credits for the API, a sandbox/test mode, limits of the free tier, and independent confirmation that real conversions run without payment.

support.subject: As a developer, a free tier, trial, or sandbox lets me test real conversions before paying

citations.quote: Register for free to get an API Key
